hook.name: UnihoodStockHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a tokenized-stock launch mechanism where each pool has a fixed per-launch swap fee (0–5%), split among the creator, platform, and a bid-wall bucket. The bid wall periodically places single-sided quote-token liquidity one tick spacing below spot; captured tokens are permanently sequestered. A graduation threshold latches once price falls to a configured tick, after which external liquidity is unlocked.
